tenderSchedule.description: Engagement of Job Work Contract for Machine-Made Raw Agarbathi Blending/Dilution, Perfume Dipping of Cleaned Raw Agarbathies, and Packing of Various Brands of Agarbathi Products and Mysore Sandal Dhoop Cones at Sandalwood Oil Division, Mysuru, for a Period of One Year.

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Karnataka Soaps and Detergent Limited, No.27, Rajaji Nagar Industrial Suburb Bengaluru-Pune Highway.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
Management reserves the right to accept or reject any or all tenders without assigning any reasons.
For any clarification refer bid documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Minimum three years experience in any industries should be furnished (Upload work order copy)

Statutory documents - a. Company Registration No. and Date of registration with Labour Department. b. PF Registration certificate. c. ESI Registration certificate. d. Copy of PAN card. e. Financial turnover of each contractor to be minimum 1.30 Crores (Average turnover for last 3 preceeding financial years to be taken together). Bidder must upload last three preceding financial years turnover certificate (i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25) along with copy of audited balance sheet and profit and loss accounts duly certified by Chartered Accountant & ITR for the years mentioned above as proof in this regard. f. GST Registration Certificate
